7.4.3.2.1 Wakeup during sleep transition in slave nodes
This section is only applicable to LIN slave nodes.
It may happen that the upper layer requests a wake-up during sleep mode transition,
after Lin_GoToSleepInternal has been called and before the sleep mode is en-
tered and the function <User>_GotoSleepConfirmation is called. In this case, the
following shall apply:
[SWS_LinIf_00760] ⌈When the LIN Interface has started the sleep mode transition
and the upper layer requests a wake-up before the sleep mode transition is completed,
the LIN Interface shall not invoke the function <User>_GotoSleepConfirmation
and restart the wakeup process by calling the function Lin_Wakeup to wake-up the
channel again.⌋
